National Library of Medicine • An induced abortion is a procedure to end a pregnancy.
It can be done two different ways: Medication abortion (also called medical abortion) and Procedural abortion.
An induced abortion is different from a spontaneous abortion.
That is the loss of a pregnancy before the 20th week of pregnancy.
It is more commonly known as a miscarriage.
